newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Post, Postbank talks broken down - magazine.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Post, Postbank talks broken down - magazine.

text.p: Negotiations between the German post office and Postbank, the independent banking wing of the postal authority, aimed at a new cooperation have broken down, the news magazine Focus reported on Saturday.

Focus said Deutsche Post AG had rejected an offer brokered by the German postal and telecommunication authority that it should receive 1.1 billion marks annually from Postbank in return for offering its products over post office counters.
The magazine said Deutsche Post had said the offer was too far below the 1.488 billion marks it is seeking.
No one was immediately available to comment at either Deutsche Post or at Postbank.
